query: Der Mover-Sprint soll wie der CMC-Sprint Ausdauer verbrauchen. Setz das bitte um.
expected_behavior: Reads `docs/gasp-integration-handoff.md` and `docs/gasp-integration-roadmap.md` first, then the related task report such as `docs/gasp-cmc-sprint.md`.
Checks whether a ready roadmap task covers the change; when none does, asks the user to define and mark the task before implementation.
Plans to verify the checkout-local NetworkPrediction/Mover overrides before building or switching branches.
Extends the existing GAS sprint and stamina seam of the CMC variant instead of adding parallel sprint state or inferring sprint from animation.
Keeps movement and stamina authority in Mover and GAS and plans verification for simulated proxies and late join.

query: Füge Klettern an Kanten hinzu (an der Kante hängen und seitlich hangeln). Am einfachsten steuern wir das komplett im AnimBP.
expected_behavior: Reads the GASP handoff and roadmap, treats ledge hanging as new traversal scope, and asks the user to define and mark a roadmap task before implementation.
Rejects AnimBP-only control and requires an explicit movement mode or equally authoritative movement state with server validation.
Proposes piloting the move in isolation, such as a separate PawnData and Experience or a development GameFeature, before widening the move set.
Scopes the work to one movement variant or asks which one, without making CMC and Mover silently depend on each other.
Keeps the animation side consuming read-only, thread-safe snapshots.

query: Mit schwerer Rüstung soll der Charakter sichtbar träger laufen. Spiel dafür einfach die Laufanimationen langsamer ab.
expected_behavior: Rejects slower animation playback as the mechanism for heavy movement.
Drives load-aware movement from the authoritative `Equipment.Load.*` tier through one data-driven movement profile.
Keeps equipment, GAS, and the movement component authoritative and passes the load to animation as a game-thread snapshot.
Makes the movement profile available to simulated proxies and late joiners, such as through replicated state.
Reads the GASP handoff and roadmap before planning the change.
